issues.title: (LOW) Fault Injection to Bypass Post-Masking
issues.cwe: CWE-1247: Improper Protection Against Voltage and Clock Glitches
issues.description: Advanced fault injection targeting the flip-flops which store the post-masking configuration can cause the these bits to be changed, allowing access to masked bits. Furthermore, OTP and PUF bits can be permanently changed in a small percentage of fault injection attempts. Such an attack requires significant time and expertise to perform and was discovered in a test environment that isolated this IP block. The rating and associated difficulty of exploitation is expected to be increased when integrated into an SoC.

issues.title: (LOW) Fault Injection to Reduce Entropy of TRNG
issues.cwe: CWE-1247: Improper Protection Against Voltage and Clock Glitches
issues.description: Advanced fault injection can bypass detection mechanisms and impact the ring oscillators that are the source of the TRNG, potentially resulting in the TRNG producing repeated non-random values. Such an attack requires significant time and expertise to perform and was discovered in a test environment that isolated this IP block. The rating and associated difficulty of exploitation is expected to be increased when integrated into an SoC.
